cards.text: Hakim's, after closing. The ledger is on the counter between the scratchcards and the till, open, because somebody has been adding to it.

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "Six months ago I couldn't have told you what we held. Now I can tell you to the jar, and who's watching it, and when it last got looked at." She taps the page. "First winter I've not lain awake counting."

cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: "She's right. It's easier. I don't have to remember anything any more, I just look."
Des turns back a page, then forward again.

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "It's all in one place now, isn't it."
Nobody takes it as a question. Hakim puts the kettle on, and the talk moves to whose round it is.
The Collective has never been safer, and never been easier to find, and nobody in the shop tonight would think to put those in the same sentence.
